message.content: {"verdict":"PARTIAL","coverage_pct":75,"agreement_pct":95,"justification":"Public supplementary artifacts allow strong independent verification of multiple central results: availability of most key supplements; recovery of canonical AMR genes within the ML-derived panels; MI ranking behavior that strongly enriches known drug targets; internal consistency of AMR labels vs LOR signs across all tested alleles; biological plausibility of allele sequences mapping to real proteins; and presence/significance of reported epistatic interactions, including all specifically discussed pairs. However, two material gaps prevent full end-to-end replication from scratch: the raw per-strain allele matrix (needed to re-fit MI/SVM and independently reproduce per-drug AUC>0.80 claims) is not provided, and the original 1595-strain cohort selection cannot be reconstructed due to PATRIC→BV-BRC identifier migration; additionally MOESM8 is inaccessible. Where checks were possible, results agree closely with the paper, with only minor naming/case issues and a known clustering truncation artifact."}
